NODE id x y z [fix=xyzXYZ] · BEAM id n1 n2 A Iy Iz J E G [ref=vx,vy,vz] [c=mm] · LOAD node fx fy fz [mx my mz] · DLOAD beam wx wy wz  (mm, N, MPa, N·mm). Lowercase = restrained translations, UPPERCASE = rotations. The example is a clamped-clamped frame with generic values — replace them with yours.
